title: sqlparse: Bug report (issue #332) from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is sqlparse (an open-source Python library). Bug report (issue #332) from a user of this library:

> For identifiers with more than two dotted parts, `get_real_name()` returns the wrong part:
>
> ```python
> sqlparse.parse("db.schema.tbl.col")[0].tokens[0].get_real_name()  # 'schema', expected 'col'
> ```
>
> Two-part names like `tbl.col` are fine. `get_parent_name()` should keep behaving as documented.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
